# Author

## Summary

A writer profile: full name, bio, portrait, contact links (email, LinkedIn, X), and a long-form markdown bio. Ships isolated, embedded, atom, and a 16-tier fitted template. Rendered as the byline (atom) on BlogPosts and as "About the author" bios under articles.

## Import

```js
import { Author } from '../author';
```

## Usage

`@field authors = linksToMany(Author)` on a post; render with `@format='atom'` for bylines.
